answer: An attacker running many fake identities must fund every bond, turning a cheap sybil swarm into real capital at risk, while honest agents treat the bond as an inlet to rewards rather than a toll. A concrete sock-puppet-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted admission with slashing: each agent must lock a bond to enter, and peers randomly audit work at epoch close. Reputation accrued across epochs forms a shared oasis of trust, and any proven duplicate identity is slashed into a canyon of loss, making mass forgery economically irrational. From qwe0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
